title: ttheme marketplace
description:
The ttheme-marketplace.toml at the root of a ttheme marketplace: a repository or folder whose palettes/*.toml and palettes/<catalog>/*.toml are the marketplace's palettes
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#marketplaces

palette.description: A palette's bare name, its file name under palettes/ without .toml

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editor completion and checks; ttheme ignores it

name.description:
The marketplace's name: its palettes are <owner>@<name>/<palette>, where the owner is the repository's owner on GitHub
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#marketplaces

description.description: What the marketplace holds, shown in ttheme browse, ttheme marketplace and the marketplace page

name.description: The owner's GitHub handle, which names a marketplace read from a folder; a marketplace added from GitHub takes its repository's owner instead

email.description: An address for questions about the marketplace

url.description: The owner's page, such as a GitHub profile

catalog.description:
The catalogs, the folders under palettes/, in the order ttheme lists them, each with an optional title in its original language and a lead palette whose colors stand for it; a folder no table names follows them, in name order
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#marketplaces

name.description: The catalog's folder under palettes/, spelled as it is there

native.description: The catalog's title in its original language, shown dim beside it

lead.description: The palette whose colors stand for the catalog in the lists

renames.description:
Palettes that were renamed or removed: an old name maps to its new name, or to false once it is gone. Installs of the old name follow the chain on the next update, so keep the entries after everyone has moved
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#marketplaces

force_remove_deleted_palettes.description: Whether a palette that leaves the marketplace without a rename is removed from the machines that installed it; by default they keep their copy

metadata.description: Anything else the owner wants to keep here; ttheme does not read it
